files.title: File:St. Charles Hospital (10760986236).jpg
files.author: Teemu008 from Palatine, Illinois
files.caption:
St. Charles Hospital in Aurora (1932). The Franciscan Sisters of the Sacred Heart came to Aurora after being persecuted in Germany during the Kulturkampf. They purchased a house, which became the second hospital in Aurora. The order purchased the rest of the houses on the block in the 1920s so that they could build a large hospital building.
